_comment: JSON Resume (https://jsonresume.org/schema/) — the format al-folio's docs call the preferred CV source.
This file is read by jekyll-get-json (see `jekyll_get_json` in _config.yml) and rendered by the
al_folio_cv plugin onto the /cv/ page. The section order shown on /cv/ is set by the `jsonresume:`
list in _config.yml — remove a section name there to hide it.
Keep this in sync with the narrative CV on the homepage (_pages/about.md).
Delete this file entirely if you would rather drive /cv/ from _data/cv.yml instead.
